title: embelia angustifolia
intro: Embelia angustifolia, commonly known as 'Tinospora cordifolia' or 'Guduchi', is a plant species in the family Menispermaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Embelia angustifolia include its ability to enhance the immune system, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
